# UC9A — Group / entitlement check — live board

**Track:** controls  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T3 · Sections: §4.1.1

## Buyer Story

A presenter needs to show the group gate deciding LIVE — flip a membership and watch the decision move — without signing in as a different user between runs.

## PingOne Solution

The /group-policy page re-reads real PingOne directory membership for every decision: the board shows one live Authorize decision per vertical for the signed-in user, and the check panel runs the same decision for any demo user on demand.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/group-policy","label":"Open group policy board"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_PAGE`

## What to Say

> Flip the membership, run the check, watch every decision move together — the policy decides, not the token.
